scripts.build: npm run data && npm run check && npm run build:de && npm run build:art
scripts.data: npm run meta && npm run lang-alt && npm run videos
scripts.build:de: SITE_LANG=de astro build && node scripts/prune-unreferenced-images.mjs dist-de && pagefind --site dist-de
scripts.build:art: SITE_LANG=en astro build && node scripts/gen-en-redirects.mjs dist-art && node scripts/prune-unreferenced-images.mjs dist-art && pagefind --site dist-art
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:de && npm run deploy:art
